title: Flesch-Kincaid Readability Calculator
description: Compute the real Flesch Reading Ease and Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level scores for any text using the standard formulas.
howto: Paste the text you want to test.
The tool counts words, sentences and syllables automatically.
Read your Flesch Reading Ease (0–100) and Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level instantly.

faqs.q: What is a good Flesch Reading Ease score?
faqs.a: 60–70 is plain English, easily understood by 13–15 year olds. 90–100 is very easy (comics); 0–30 is very difficult (academic papers).

faqs.q: What is the Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level?
faqs.a: The US school grade needed to understand the text. A score of 8.0 means an eighth-grader should comprehend it.
